## getPageDialog(page, dialogid) ⇒ <code>A11yDialog</code>
Gets the dialog for a page, creating it if needed
(more than one button can open the same page)

**Kind**: global function  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| page | <code>String</code> | page name |
| dialogid | <code>String</code> | id of the dialog element |
